answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on both classification and generation tasks, including GSM8k , IFEval , MMLU , Common-senseQA , PiQA , and HotpotQA .
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include generated answers for classification and generation tasks, which are evaluated for correctness during self-correction.

answer_2.quote: For classification tasks, we focus only on probabilities over the candidate label set L, not the whole vocabulary V . Thus, we discard most logits, retaining only those corresponding to candidate labels, producing a reduced logit vector ... After applying the softmax function, the model predicts the probabilities for each label P (l 0 ), P (l 1 ), . . . , P (l K-1 ).
